title: Technology Sector Update for 11/20/2018: PSTG, INTU, PLUS, MSFT, CSCO, IBM, GOOG, AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -2.89%
AAPL: -3.59%
IBM: -1.15%
CSCO: -0.85%
GOOG: -2.31%
Technology stocks were trending down in pre-market trading Tuesday.
Moving stocks include:
(+) Pure Storage ( PSTG ), which was 4% higher after the company reported better-than-expected fiscal Q3 results.
In other sector news:
(-) Intuit's ( INTU ) was slightly down though its adjusted EPS rose to $0.29 in Q1 from $0.17 a year earlier, more than doubling analysts' estimates of $0.11 in a Capital IQ poll.
(=) ePlus ( PLUS ) was unchanged as the company advised that its full-year results will likely surpass market expectations thanks to continued positive performance since it published its third quarter trading update last month.
